Holo with minimum image tokens 1024 still missed: normalized [920,530] mapped to [883.2,301.04], outside x829..944/y380..416. No action or production flag change.

Q6 uses the identical frozen production request SHA256 40800ec0f9d3a0211b9c90abb773947b95268bab143a85526011fc2d7122f805 and pinned projector. It terminates with all six requested facts and the exact link; the compiled production Swift decoder/oracle passes.
Actual Q6 local typing/login/Resume passes: Tokyo entered once, Seattle preserved, early Resume does not infer or replay, one window retained.

Q6 full movie01 reaches the correct screening but rejects a wheel scroll and requests unsupported PageDown before prices are visible. Thirteen proposals, 196.15 seconds. Guard blocks the key before dispatch.

Native PageDown/PageUp use AppKit function key characters/codes/flag and a retained plain-document DOM focus. Editable/composite/native Find targets are refused. Fresh authentication, ownership, native responder and one-shot observation gates remain.
New windows realize their WebKit view and receive initial browser focus only on creation. Repeated presentation/capture does not reclaim user focus or recreate the window.

Paging red-01 had an async XCTest autoclosure compile error; red-02 reproduced the missing AgentTarget. Early green attempts reported a cleanup transition error; a local catch isolated the actual dispatch rejection: NSWindow was first responder, pageChanged, zero attempts. Initial browser focus repairs it.

The first boundary group leaked deliberately cleared native focus into later fixture cases. Explicit fixture-only focus reset repairs isolation; production preserves cleared user focus. Fifteen rejection variants pass across two methods.
Native trusted PageDown/PageUp direction, unchanged quantity, consumed-observation rejection, 15 boundaries, public Veezi price/fee reveal, window reuse, Tab typing and Find regressions pass.

Q6 full movie02 still fails: restrictive searches return irrelevant results, then a manual search-field Select All proposal hits stale-agent-control after earlier rejected actions.
